_note: Force a native verdict for a GBIF species name the automatic matcher gets wrong. Keys are GBIF `species` values. nztcs_name is the NZTCS taxon it corresponds to, where there is one. Checked against nztcs.json on 2026-11-09.

Shawia rani.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Olearia rani (Endemic)

Paratrophis microphylla.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Streblus heterophyllus (Endemic)

Quintinia acutifolia.why: GBIF lumps Q. serrata into Q. acutifolia; NZTCS Quintinia serrata (Endemic)

Nertera granadensis.why: GBIF lumps N. depressa into N. granadensis; NZTCS Nertera depressa (Non-endemic)

Urtica incisa.why: NZ plants once called U. incisa are U. sykesii in NZTCS (Non-endemic)

Hypolepis rugosula.why: native ring fern; NZTCS splits the NZ plants among other Hypolepis names

Fuchsia colensoi.why: native hybrid (F. excorticata x F. perscandens), not assessed by NZTCS

Melicope mantellii.why: native hybrid (M. simplex x M. ternata), not assessed by NZTCS

Styphelia nesophila.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Leucopogon fraseri (Non-endemic)

Coprosma pumila.why: GBIF lumps C. perpusilla into C. pumila; NZTCS Coprosma perpusilla (Non-endemic)

Chionochloa rubra.nztcs_name: Chionochloa rubra subsp. rubra var. rubra
Chionochloa rubra.why: red tussock; NZTCS lists only subspecies, nominate used (Endemic)

Hymenophyllum rarum.why: NZ plants are NZTCS Hymenophyllum aff. rarum (Endemic)

Shawia nummularifolia.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Olearia nummulariifolia (Endemic)

Shawia arborescens.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Olearia arborescens (Endemic)

Shawia virgata.why: GBIF genus transfer; NZTCS Olearia virgata (Endemic)

Anthosachne scabra.why: native blue wheatgrass (NZ and Australia), not in NZTCS

Celmisia pseudolyallii.why: endemic mountain daisy, not in NZTCS
